scope: Local three-player model training, inference and interruption recovery; browser/network/deployment acceptance is separate.

training.boundary: Behavior cloning from existing two-player Minimax followed by three-player MaxN teachers. No game-strength or formal RL claim.

checks: Artifact SHA-256 and every recorded training source byte hash match
All legal candidates scored with finite logits and normalized priors
Complete source state preserved on success and injected failure
Each single-AI seat and each pair of AI seats finish bounded size-5 fixtures
Actual async AIWorker branch preserves request ID, rules version, current player and position revision
Malformed model, missing training provenance and unsupported player count rejected
inference_verification.timing_boundary: One local CPU probe per seat and size; not a device or performance guarantee.

checks: Force-kill a live generator after its first durable episode
Resume without repeating the completed episode
Compare the resumed checkpoint and samples exactly with clean execution
Quarantine an incomplete trailing temporary write
Reject checkpoint corruption and source/config identity drift
